goal: Allow an authorized Slack user to compact the current dedicated Pi gateway session with acknowledgement-before-compaction and proactive nonce-bound supervisor recovery.

userStories.title: Gateway-only Slack command parser and acknowledgement state machine
acceptanceCriteria: Only exact bridge-stamped Slack command messages trigger
Natural grammar and optional bounded /compact instructions are tested
A non-empty tool-free acknowledgement turn precedes ctx.compact
Duplicate, error, and session lifecycle states are one-shot and reset safely

userStories.title: Nonce-bound proactive supervisor recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Supervisor owns a fresh unpredictable nonce per Pi launch
Extension is loaded third and receives nonce only in the dedicated Pi gateway
Only current onComplete marker triggers recorded restart/reconnect
Stale ctx, crashes, locks, heartbeat, Hermes, and interactive TTY behavior remain intact

userStories.title: Regression tests, probe, and operator documentation
acceptanceCriteria: Vitest and shell tests cover extension and launch wiring
Slack and upstream docs describe trust, scope, behavior, caveat, and troubleshooting
